name: home-noise-evidence-log
title: 针对重复的家庭噪音建立冷静、真实的日志，包括带时间戳的事件、证明注释、模式摘要和
description: Build a calm, factual log for repeated home noise, including timestamped incidents, proof notes, pattern summary, and a neutral message draft for management, an HOA, a landlord, or a neighbor. Use when the user wants documentation and de-escalating communication, not legal advice or confrontation coaching.
